usageNotes: Retrieves time-series performance data (CPU, memory, network, disk I/O) for an LXC container from the node's RRD database. The container must exist on the specified node and the caller needs VM.Audit on /vms/{vmid}. Use 'AVERAGE' for trend graphs and 'MAX' to surface peak spikes; omitting 'cf' lets Proxmox apply its default consolidation.

examples.summary: Fetch the last hour of average performance data for container 110

tips: Returned data points are spaced according to the RRD resolution for the chosen timeframe — finer resolution for 'hour', coarser for 'year'.
Fields in each returned object vary by what metrics Proxmox has recorded; check for null/missing keys before graphing.
If the container was recently created or was stopped for most of the window, many data points will be empty or zero.
MAX consolidation is most useful for 'week' or longer timeframes where average values can mask short bursts.
